title: Women's Capybara – Per My Last Email, I'm Soaking Hoodie

seo.title: Capybara Hoodie for Women: Per My Last Email, I'm Soaking
seo.description: A capybara hoodie for women: a capybara in a hot spring with a mandarin on its head and PER MY LAST EMAIL, I'M SOAKING. Printed to order, free US shipping on $45+.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This capybara hoodie says PER MY LAST EMAIL, I'M SOAKING. for the woman whose out-of-office reply is a hot spring and who has answered enough follow-ups for one week.

A calm capybara sits chest-deep in a steaming spring ringed with smooth stones, a mandarin balanced on its head. PER MY LAST EMAIL, runs across the top and I'M SOAKING. across the bottom in orange, both outlined for a clean read.

Pull it on for remote-work Fridays, long weekends and cold evenings at home. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does the capybara soaking hoodie come in?
The Women's Capybara Per My Last Email, I'm Soaking hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Navy. On Sand the top line is printed in dark brown ink and on Navy it is cream, so every word, the capybara and the orange stay easy to read on both.

Is it a good gift for a capybara lover?
Yes. The Per My Last Email, I'm Soaking hoodie suits any capybara fan with a stressful inbox, on an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for winter. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order; order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Per My Last Email, I'm Soaking hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. capybara hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier, cozier fit over a long-sleeve layer on a cold morning at home.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the lettering and the capybara's hot spring looking sharp wash after wash.

Where does the print sit?
The Per My Last Email, I'm Soaking print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, about ten inches wide, with the email line on top, the capybara in the middle and I'M SOAKING. underneath. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order on the front only.
